newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Plessey completes 64 mln rand upgrade.
newsitem.headline: Plessey completes 64 mln rand upgrade.

text.p: Plessey Corp Ltd has completed a 64 million rand upgrade of its Cape Town and East London plants, chief executive John Temple said on Tuesday.
The Cape Town plant had been damaged in a fire in February while new equipment was installed in East London.

Temple said that the upgrade had been complemented by the restructuring of the group into three divisions -- Plessey Communications, Plessey Electronics and consumer electronics, including the Telefunken and Pioneer brands.
